correctness.rationale: For the intrinsic-volume uniform regular simplex conv(e_1,...,e_n), X~Dirichlet(1^n), Q=ΣX_i², M=max X_i,m=min X_i and squared distances R=1+Q-2M, T=1+Q-2m. Dirichlet polynomial moments and conditioning on m, plus maximum-event inclusion-exclusion, give each of Var(Q), Cov(Q,M), Cov(Q,m), Cov(M,m), hence the displayed exact negative covariance. The n>=7 harmonic inequality (H_7-1)^2>2+2/7 controls the entire infinite tail; independent exact Fraction evaluation confirms n=2..6. Variances Var(R)~2π²/(3n²), Var(T)~4/n³ yield Corr(R,T)~-sqrt(3/2)(log n)^2/(πsqrt n). Only squared Euclidean distances and uniform regular simplices are proved.
